This composition matches a maraging steel in the C300/C350 family. It has 17.5% Ni, 11.8% Co, 3.9% Mo and 1.54% Ti. The Ti level is high and the Mo level is slightly high, so the strength should sit above C300 and close to C350 or higher. Aged C350 yields at roughly 2400 MPa. This is an estimate from alloy-family knowledge, not a calculation.
